title: 13 Best AI Tools for Property Management in 2026
summary: 13 AI property management tools grouped by job: guest messages and calls, turnovers, pricing and owner reports, and long-term leasing.
body_markdown:
The best AI property management software in 2026 depends on the job you need done. If guest messages and phone calls take most of your week, start with Akia or Conduit, which run both on one agent. Turnover managers should look at Breezeway, Properly and RapidEye, nightly pricing points to Beyond, PriceLabs and Wheelhouse (Beyond adds owner reports), and long-term leasing has EliseAI, STAN AI and Zuma.


## How did we order this list?


The order of this list comes from grouping these 13 AI property management tools by job: guest messages and calls, operations and turnovers, pricing and owner reporting, and long-term leasing and residents. Within each group, tools are listed alphabetically, because vendors report results in different units (share of messages, resolution rate, hours saved) that cannot be ranked against each other. Facts come from vendor pages read November 26, 2026. Built-in PMS AI gets its own unranked section, and Conduit, our product, sits where the alphabet puts it.


## Which AI tools handle guest messages and calls?


Guest messaging and call tools handle routine inquiries across OTA inboxes, SMS and phone lines before tickets reach staff. Akia and Conduit run messages and calls on one agent, while Enso Connect and HostBuddy AI focus on written messaging. Compare phone tools in our[AI receptionist guide](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-receptionist-vacation-rentals) .


### 1. Akia


[Akia](https://www.akia.com/) says "the same Akia that answers your messages runs your phone line," and it takes payment during the call. Akia has 2,000+ customers and says up to 90% of messages never reach your team. AI Voice is part of Akia's Max tier, and Akia does not publish prices on[its pricing page](https://www.akia.com/pricing) .


### 2. Conduit


Conduit works in 140+ languages, writes changes back to connected PMSs, dispatches maintenance, and generates a new access code from the PMS when a guest calls locked out.[Messaging](https://www.conduit.ai/pricing) starts at $18/unit/month with Voice AI, with volume pricing past 50 units, and the Startup plan is $899/month for up to 25 units with every Full Suite feature. Conduit: best for multi-unit vacation rental operators because Haven Vacation Rentals runs at 90% automation on Conduit. Conduit is a full platform, so a five-listing host who only wants message drafts is buying more than needed.


### 3. Enso Connect


[Enso Connect](https://ensoconnect.com/pricing) pairs EnsoAI messaging with its Boarding Pass portal, which sells stay upsells. Enso reports 95% of guest communication automated and $50M+ in upsell revenue. Pricing is per unit with a 5-unit minimum: Core runs up to $20 per unit per month on monthly billing ($16 on yearly), Pro and Max cost more, and larger portfolios pay less per unit. It fits operators who want messaging and portal upsells in one product.


### 4. HostBuddy AI


[HostBuddy AI](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/) connects to your PMS to run written guest messaging, answering guest questions, guiding troubleshooting, escalating issues, and surfacing action items for staff. HostBuddy serves 25,000+ properties and has processed 40M+ messages. Published monthly plans on[HostBuddy's pricing page](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/pricing) cost $7/property for Pro, $10/property for Elite, and $12/property for Ultimate.


## Which AI tools run operations and turnovers?


Operations and turnover AI tools coordinate housekeeping schedules, flag at-risk jobs and check post-stay photos before the next check-in. Breezeway's agents act on tasks and guest messages, Properly pairs AI with human photo reviewers, and RapidEye runs automated damage detection on turnover photos and video. For photo checks in depth, see our[AI property inspection guide](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-property-inspection-software-vacation-rentals) .


### 5. Breezeway


[Breezeway](https://www.breezeway.io/ai) runs two AI agents. Controller ranks the day's risks (like unstarted cleans or unassigned jobs) and the staff who can cover them, and Concierge answers guest questions, sends troubleshooting steps before creating tasks, and quotes upsells. The Operations platform starts at $19.99/unit/month on Host Essentials (under 5 properties) and larger portfolios are quoted; on[Breezeway's pricing page](https://www.breezeway.io/pricing) , Concierge is an add-on that requires the Operations + Guest Experience plan and is quoted per messaging-enabled home.


### 6. Properly


[Properly](https://getproperly.com/pricing/) offers turnover software at $12.99/property/month with a 30-day free trial, paired with Real-Time Inspection at $5 per inspection where AI-assisted expert reviewers examine cleaner photos and flag problems before check-in. Its Pro plan syncs with Guesty and Hostaway, and more than 10,000 hosts across 45+ countries use Properly for turnovers.


### 7. RapidEye


[RapidEye](https://rapideyeinspections.com/pricing) runs AI damage detection on every post-checkout turnover photo, with room-by-room baseline comparisons, on its Photos plan. The Operations plan adds video inspections, back-to-back damage attribution and owner-ready condition reports. Pricing is per inspected unit on quote, and the per-unit rate drops as the portfolio grows.


## Which AI tools set prices and report to owners?


Dynamic pricing tools set nightly rates, and Beyond also writes owner reports. Beyond, PriceLabs and Wheelhouse price either per listing or as a share of bookings, and the two models cross at a predictable point. On Wheelhouse, 20 listings on Pro Flat cost $339.80 a month (20 × $16.99), and Pro Flex at 1% costs the same when those listings book $33,980 that month, about $1,699 per listing.


### 8. Beyond


[Beyond](https://www.beyondpricing.com/pricing) offers dynamic pricing on Free, Growth (1% of bookings), and Pro (1.25%), with no booking fee until your first $5,000 in bookings. Its[Owner Hub](https://beyondpricing.com/products/owner-hub) add-on starts at $30/month with Projections, Listing Lens, and Owner Reports with market context and an editable AI summary, and Beyond says Owner Hub saves 9 hours of reporting a month for a portfolio of 50 listings across 30 owners.


### 9. PriceLabs


[PriceLabs](https://hello.pricelabs.co/) prices 600,000+ properties every day and connects to 160+ PMSs. On[PriceLabs' pricing page](https://hello.pricelabs.co/pricing/) , flat-rate dynamic pricing starts at $19.99/listing/month in the US, UK, Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Israel, discounted from the second listing. A 1% of booking revenue plan is the other option.


### 10. Wheelhouse


[Wheelhouse](https://www.usewheelhouse.com/pricing) automates nightly rates across two billing models. Pro Flex charges 1% of revenue with a $2.99 monthly minimum. Pro Flat costs $19.99 per listing a month, or $16.99 at 10 to 49 listings, and portfolios of 50+ listings get custom pricing.


## Which AI tools handle long-term leasing and residents?


Long-term leasing and resident AI tools serve multifamily, residential rental and HOA managers alongside or separately from short-term rentals. EliseAI publishes its channel and language coverage, STAN AI a resolution rate at a named customer, and Zuma a response-time figure, and none of the three publishes pricing.


### 11. EliseAI


[EliseAI](https://eliseai.com/) provides housing AI across text, email, chat, and voice, handling phone calls in seven languages and written replies in 51. EliseAI states it raised $350M at a $4B valuation and sells through custom quotes without public pricing.


### 12. STAN AI


[STAN AI](https://stan.ai/) pairs 24/7 Resident AI across call, text, email, and chat with Manager AI for back-office work, priced per portfolio without public tiers. In its[case study](https://www.stan.ai/blog-posts/how-4sight-property-management-resolves-99-1-of-resident-conversations-and-turns-days-of-work-into-minutes-with-stan-ai) , 4Sight Property Management (about 14,000 doors, 82 community associations) resolved 99.1% of resident conversations without staff from November 1, 2025, through October 31, 2026.


### 13. Zuma


[Zuma](https://www.getzuma.com/) builds an AI agent named Kelsey to handle multifamily leasing inquiries, tour scheduling, rent collection reminders, move-outs, and VoiceAI phone calls, and Zuma does not publish pricing. Zuma's site publishes 53% faster responses for leasing teams, and[Venn acquired Zuma](https://venn.city/resources/venn-acquires-zuma-for-50-million) for $50 million in a deal announced September 22, 2026.


## What about the AI built into your PMS?


Built-in PMS AI handles baseline messaging and tasks inside software you already run. For short-term rentals,[Hostaway offers AI CoHost](https://www.hostaway.com/features/ai-cohost/) ,[Guesty offers ReplyAI, AI Autopilot, and AI Task Creation](https://www.guesty.com/features/unified-inbox/) , and[Hospitable includes Inbox AI](https://hospitable.com/pricing) . For long-term portfolios,[AppFolio offers Realm-X](https://www.appfolio.com/ai) , which AppFolio says now connects directly to Anthropic's Claude, and[Buildium offers Lumina AI](https://www.buildium.com/features/ai-property-management-software/) across billing, communications, leasing, maintenance, and reporting. Start with what your PMS includes, then add a specialist tool for the job it does not cover.

## How much does AI property management software cost?


AI property management software uses three pricing models: per unit or per listing (HostBuddy AI from $7/property/month), a share of bookings (Beyond Growth at 1%), and quotes on request (Akia, RapidEye, EliseAI, STAN AI and Zuma). Most managers stack two or three tools, because each one covers a single job.


For a 20-unit vacation rental manager whose listings book $40,000 a month, HostBuddy AI Pro ($140, 20 × $7) plus Beyond Growth at 1% ($400) comes to $540 a month, counting from after the first $5,000 in bookings, which Beyond does not charge on. Adding Properly's platform for turnovers ($259.80, 20 × $12.99) brings the stack to $799.80, before any $5 inspections.


## FAQ


Short answers to the questions property managers ask while shortlisting follow, including two that the list above does not settle on its own: what you can try for free, and which tools already sit inside Guesty and Hostaway. Prices and trial lengths come from the vendor pricing pages linked in each entry.


### What is the best AI for property management?


The best AI for property management is the one built for the job that takes your team the most hours. Guest messages and calls point to Akia, Conduit, Enso Connect or HostBuddy AI, turnovers to Breezeway, Properly or RapidEye, nightly pricing to Beyond, PriceLabs or Wheelhouse, and long-term portfolios to EliseAI, STAN AI or Zuma.


### Can AI answer property management phone calls?


Yes. Akia and Conduit answer phone calls on the same agent that handles guest messages, and EliseAI, STAN AI and Zuma include voice for long-term housing. Our list of AI receptionists for vacation rentals compares the phone tools in more detail.


### Is there free AI property management software?


Beyond's Free plan includes market dashboards and its Neyoba AI assistant but leaves your prices alone, and its paid plans charge no booking fee until your first $5,000 in bookings. HostBuddy AI gives 2 weeks free, and Properly offers a 30-day free trial of its $12.99/property/month platform.


### Does AI replace a property manager?


No. The tools here automate routine replies, nightly pricing and photo checks, and each one hands the case to a person when it cannot finish. Even the highest resolution rate on this list leaves some resident conversations for staff.


### Which AI tools work with Guesty or Hostaway?


Guesty includes ReplyAI, AI Autopilot and AI Task Creation, and Hostaway includes AI CoHost inside the PMS. Among the specialist tools here, Akia's voice page, Conduit's answering-service page and Properly's Pro plan name both PMSs, and the other vendors list their integrations on their own sites.


### Is AI used for long-term rentals too?


Yes. EliseAI, STAN AI and Zuma automate leasing, tours, rent reminders and resident support for residential, multifamily and HOA portfolios, and AppFolio and Buildium build AI into their long-term PMSs as Realm-X and Lumina AI.
